create_mutox_model: create a MutoxClassifier model from a MutoxConfig with input_size 1024
build_mutox_classifier: build a MutoxClassifier with a sequential neural network of dropout, linear, and ReLU layers
test_mutox_forward: test the MutoxClassifier forward pass with a torch.Tensor input and output_prob flag
review_mutox_config: review the MutoxConfig dataclass that holds the input_size configuration for the classifier
summarize_mutox_model: summarize the MutoxClassifier module that wraps a sequential model and optionally applies sigmoid
